projects.title: A Passage Through the Exoskeleton
projects.description: A twisting tower shaped around a vertical public passage, with an exoskeleton that frames the opening and selected floors that bridge across it.
projects.body:
This project explores how a tall, twisting tower can make room for a public passage through its center. The opening gives the mass a more open profile and creates a route through the building, while the exterior exoskeleton traces the changing form.

The floor plates respond to that cut. Most stop at the passage, while every third slab continues across it to form a bridge between the two sides. This rhythm keeps the opening legible while reconnecting the tower at regular intervals.

The Grasshopper definition brings the tower profile, twist, taper, exoskeleton, passage, and floor behavior into one adjustable system. The current work focuses on making the structure meet the passage edges cleanly and on testing how the floor bridges read within the larger facade.

The visuals below are temporary illustrations used to hold the page layout and communicate the design direction. They are not final renderings of the Rhino model and can be replaced when project-specific views are ready.

blocks.content: The first reference frames the passage as a sequence of planted terraces and shared outdoor rooms.

blocks.content: A second view helps test how the opening and exterior lattice might read from the waterfront.
